mapper.select: /* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectResidentAptCmplexNo */ SELECT au.apt_cmplex_no FROM hshld_head hh JOIN apt_detail ad ON hh.ho_no = ad.ho_no JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE hh.user_no = #{userNo} AND NVL(hh.inout_cd, 'IN') != 'OUT' AND ROWNUM = 1

/* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectFacilityStatusCardList */
SELECT f.facility_no facilityNo /* 시설번호 */ , f.facility_nm facilityNm /* 시설명 */ , f.facility_ty_cd facilityTyCd /* 시설유형코드 */ , TO_CHAR(fch.chk_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') chkDt /* 최근 점검일 */ , NVL(fch.chk_stts_cd, '점검대기') chkSttsCd /* 점검상태 */ , NVL(fch.chk_cn, '최근 점검 이력 없음') chkCn /* 점검내용 */ , fch.chk_ty_cd chkTyCd /* 점검유형코드 */ , p.partner_nm partnerNm /* 협력업체명 */ , NVL(p.pic_nm, p.partner_nm) picNm /* 담당자명 */ FROM facility f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fac_chk_hstry_no , facility_no , partner_no , chk_dt , chk_stts_cd , chk_cn , chk_ty_cd , reg_dt , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY facility_no ORDER BY chk_dt DESC NULLS LAST , reg_dt DESC NULLS LAST , fac_chk_hstry_no DESC ) rn FROM facility_check_hstry ) fch ON f.facility_no = fch.facility_no AND fch.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN partner p ON fch.partner_no = p.partner_no WHERE f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND NVL(f.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY f.facility_ty_cd , f.facility_nm
